name: rct-notebook
tagline_zh: 别再对着 PDF 划线了。喂进论文，它按 CONSORT 2025 逐条核对。
tagline_en: Stop scribbling on PDFs. Feed it a paper, it cross-checks every CONSORT 2025 item and renders a cited visual.
desc_en: Author a marimo notebook that reads a randomized controlled trial through the CONSORT 2025 checklist. Use when building a visual, auditable trial summary from a paper (PDF or verified public sources) for the rct-visualization repo.
why_zh: 不是摘要式总结，而是把随机对照试验的每个环节映射到清单条目，缺失项、模糊项直接标红。
why_en: Not a summary—it maps every trial component to checklist items, flags missing or vague entries in red, shrinking review from.
limit_zh: 只认 PDF 或可验证的公开来源，不读私有数据库；产物是 marimo notebook，不是论文改写或统计重算。
limit_en: Accepts only PDFs or verifiable public sources, not private databases. Output is a marimo notebook—no rewriting or re-analysis. Non-CONSORT.
title_en: Turn a trial paper into an auditable marimo notebook.
